connector.name: Eurostat MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Search and query the Eurostat catalogue - EU economy, demography, trade, and NUTS regional data.
connector.summary: Hosted at eurostat.caseyjhand.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package eurostat-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cyanheads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
